liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (3 reviews): There is an amusing false start and do-over on Masterpiece; The restarted Masterpiece raised the show's energy, which carried through the end [11][12][16]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet/Fire is described as spectacular; Scarlet/Fire is described as on [9][10]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): The show opens with a ripping Bucket that leads into a sweet Sugaree [8]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Jerry plays every lick cleanly in Sugaree, and likewise in Bird Song [8]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): The organ on Walkin' Blues is stellar, and also shines on Friend of the Devil [11]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Reviewer enjoys a smokin' Cumberland Blues [16]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): A subtle jam with heavy Other One teasing comes out of He's Gone [11]
- **Drums** (1 review): Creative second-set playing between Drums, Jam and the Other One teases [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Other One tease**: rare: 7 archived performances [19]
- **The Other One tease reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd91-02-20.aud.Nak100-CP4.eD.11271.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 4.57/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: The sound is described as meatier than usual; Reviewer calls the sound nice; Reviewer ranks it among the best-sounding audience recordings on the archive [9][12][14]
- **gd91-02-20.sbd.hinko.28471.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 197 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Keyboards are strong throughout, giving the show a different, nice feel [10]
- **gd1991-02-20.141851.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 199 min [3]
- **gd1991-02-20.141769.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 199 min [4]

## Around the show

- Bobby began Masterpiece in too high a key; the band stopped a few lyrics in and restarted [12]
- Reviewer says Vince is amazingly right on [17]
- Reviewer says it sounded like an 80s show, minus Brent, with a new keyboardist [8]
- No Hornsby on this one; Jerry fills the gap with inspired playing [9]
- Reviewer calls the first set one of the best of the entire year [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-02-20.aud.Nak100-CP4.eD.11271.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Charlie Miller; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300/cp4 + AKG C1000S -> Boss BX4 Mixer -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) [1]. Also: Charlie Miller taped it from front row center in the tapers section using a four-microphone mix; Miller says he may someday transfer directly from the cassette master to computer; Recorded by Charlie Miller, passed along via Paul, and seeded to etree by eD (efojr) [1][7]
- **gd91-02-20.sbd.hinko.28471.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: flac16 SBD > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC [2]
- **gd1991-02-20.141851.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1991-02-20.141769.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Michael: [1991-02-21 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-02-21-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [20]
